scope: same-time real-AGRI to station GHI retrieval; two Hunan stations

target.clear_sky: Ineichen at corresponding interval midpoints; mean over same three intervals

input.agri: 13 Hunan AGRI channels, station-centered 3x3 at real target time
input.day_mask: sample eligibility only (station SZA<90deg), not an image channel
input.cot: AC only: co-registered physical COT 3x3 from the accepted R on the same real AGRI frame
input.normalization: AGRI and COT train-only statistics, one COT log1p transform; no per-image centering or spatial averaging

architecture.aux_encoder: AC: Conv2d(1,4,1)+SiLU on COT; AP: Conv2d(32,4,1)+SiLU on AGRI/geometry features
architecture.readout: fixed row-major flatten of spatial feature planes; Linear(width*9,64)+SiLU+Linear(64,32)+SiLU+Linear(32,1)+Softplus

training.sample_budget: same station, target keys, order and updates across paired arms; no arm-specific early stop

preexisting_cpu_witness: windows/window_2/head_witness_v0.json; synthetic CPU prototype passed shape, finite output, COT dependency/gradient and parameter match
limitations: The new monthly R was trained from random initialization on the new monthly train/validation split and passed independent FP64 rescoring against CPP-supported validation labels; it is not independently verified physical truth.
The new-R COT bank is complete for 55,733 unique train/validation frames with zero source errors; its checkpoint and candidate hashes are recorded in bank_manifest.json.
The matched GHI-head pack will join samples by (station,target_time_utc), use the main train/validation mask, preserve 3x3 spatial positions, and fit AGRI/COT normalization on train samples only.
The matched pack is being materialized by PBS 213781.tc6000. No GHI head training has started; a single-card profile will determine the common batch before the matched seed42 pilot.
